title: e was discovered by asking how interest compounds
body: Jacob Bernoulli asked in 1683 what happens if interest compounds ever more often within a year. Yearly doubling gives 2, continuous compounding settles at about 2.71828, not infinity: the limit of (1+1/n)^n. The number e is thus baked into growth itself, which is why it keeps reappearing wherever change feeds on itself.
